main_text.p: quibus rectè utiliterq;[?] imperii tractari gubernacula nequeunt. Vos ita cum re-liquis studiis Ciceronis lectionem, styliq; coniungitis exercitationes sedulò ac fe-liciter : ut cùm hoc nomine, tum multis aliis merito sibi gaudeat, qui Vobis ad-iunctus D.BERNHARDUS RV-LOVIVS : vir literatus: præceptor fi-dus: moderator diligens : gratuler ego antiquissimæ atque illustrissimæ domui Lunæburgensi: CHRISTUM denique Optimum Maximum precer : lucis bu-ius diuturna Vos usura donare:ita quo-que porrò studia Vestra Spiritu guber-nare suo dignetur: ut egregium aliquan-do in Vobis, nonsubditi modo, verùm etiam alii paratum præsidium habeant. Et munusculum ergo hoc levidense fere-na fronte accipietis,nec Celsitudine Ve-stra, sed donatis animo æstimabitis: ꝙ, quod summisse peto, solita me clemen-

page.notes: Running head is set in spaced small capitals. Doubtful readings: "utiliterq;" (final mark unclear), "RV-" in "RV-LOVIVS" (first letters of the name hard to read), "summisse" (double s may be ss or ff). Page number "5" and signature ")(" read from the foot. Text breaks at a hyphen at the page end ("clemen-"), so the paragraph continues on the next page.
